cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port your app can listen on (TCP). It is also passed to the app as the PORT environment variable

gitrepo.desc: HTTPS URL of a git repository to download on install, for example https://github.com/user/my-bot.git. Reinstalling pulls the latest commit. Leave empty to upload the files yourself

gitbranch.desc: Branch to check out. Empty means the default branch of the repository

gittoken.desc: Personal access token for a private repository (GitHub, GitLab). Leave empty for public repositories

startfile.desc: Python file to run, relative to the server folder

installonstart.desc: Run pip install -r requirements.txt before every start, so new packages are picked up

commands: bash -c "set -e; if [ -z \"$GIT_REPO\" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"Installing git in the install container\"; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null; else echo \"git is not installed, it is needed to download the repository\"; exit 1; fi; fi; g() { git -c safe.directory='*' -c init.defaultBranch=main -c advice.detachedHead=false \"$@\"; }; auth=(); if [ -n \"$GIT_TOKEN\" ]; then auth=(-c \"http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf 'oauth2:%s' \"$GIT_TOKEN\" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')\"); fi; [ -d .git ] || g init -q; echo \"Fetching $GIT_REPO ${GIT_BRANCH:-(default branch)}\"; g \"${auth[@]}\" fetch -q --depth 1 \"$GIT_REPO\" \"${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}\"; g reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo \"Checked out $(g log -1 --format='%h %s')\""

install.text:
# Placeholder written by Aether Panel. Replace this file with your app, or set a git
# repository in the server settings and reinstall.
import platform

print("Aether Panel: Python " + platform.python_version() + " is running ${startfile}. Upload your app, or set a git repository and reinstall.")

commands: bash -c "set -e; PY=python3; if command -v \"python${pyversion}\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=\"python${pyversion}\"; fi; V=\"$($PY -c 'import sys; print(\"%d.%d\" % sys.version_info[:2])')\"; if [ -d .venv ] && [ ! -d \".venv/lib/python$V\" ]; then echo \"Python version changed, recreating .venv\"; rm -rf .venv; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then echo \"Creating the virtual environment .venv (Python $V)\"; $PY -m venv .venv; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then echo \"Installing requirements.txt\"; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; fi"

run.command: bash -c "set -e; unset GIT_TOKEN; PY=python3; if command -v \"python${pyversion}\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then PY=\"python${pyversion}\"; fi; V=\"$($PY -c 'import sys; print(\"%d.%d\" % sys.version_info[:2])')\"; if [ -d .venv ] && [ ! -d \".venv/lib/python$V\" ]; then echo \"Python version changed, recreating .venv\"; rm -rf .venv; fi; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then echo \"Creating the virtual environment .venv (Python $V)\"; $PY -m venv .venv; fi; if [ \"${installonstart}\" = true ]; then if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then echo \"Installing requirements.txt\"; .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt; fi; fi; exec .venv/bin/python -u \"${startfile}\""
